adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired worker-2 activity rows, worker-4 DRAMP conflict adjudication, and worker-6 final review for the Akt-responsive BH3BIM peptide paper. The paper is publication-grade with cautions because supported anticancer/cytotoxic and BCL-2-family binding evidence is retained, while DRAMP antimicrobial and terminal-modification overclaims remain explicit source_conflicts.

materials_exhausted.note: XML/PDF/OA package figures/DOCX supplement/database packet were exhausted for worker-2/4/6 blockers. Landing .bin supplement files are publisher HTML duplicates and the DOCX contains supplementary figure legends, not structured activity tables.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP literature linkage and peptide names/sequences trace to this paper, but database antimicrobial labels and free terminal modifications conflict with primary evidence; all six DRAMP rows remain source_conflict with explicit context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary text/figures support BCL-2/BCL-XL binding KD values and cancer-cell viability/apoptosis assays. Database-only antimicrobial annotations were not promoted as source assay rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct mechanism is scoped to Akt phosphorylation, enhanced BCL-2/BCL-XL binding/competition, and intrinsic apoptosis/BAX dependence; no antimicrobial mechanism is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_decision: Open ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is closable because the specific worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 omissions were source-reviewed and no blocking material gap remains.

caution_findings.note: DRAMP labels the peptides Antimicrobial, Anticancer; the opened primary article supports anticancer/cancer-cell cytotoxicity and BCL-2-family binding, not antimicrobial assay activity.
DRAMP rows list free N/C termini while the primary peptide methods state synthetic peptides had acetylated amino termini and amidated carboxyl termini.
Figure-only OD540/live-cell values were retained as qualitative or approximate graph evidence with panel statistics; unsupported exact digitization was not invented.
DOCX supplement contains figure legends/images only; local landing .bin files are publisher HTML duplicates and add no table values.
Mechanism acceptance is limited to Akt-dependent anticancer apoptosis and BCL-2-family binding; no antimicrobial mechanism is accepted.
